findings.title: ci-bot can read secrets cluster-wide
findings.evidence: binding ci-secrets grants get on secrets
findings.verification_evidence: ClusterRoleBinding/ci-secrets binds ServiceAccount ci/ci-bot to ClusterRole secret-reader, whose rule gives verbs ["get","list"] on resources ["secrets"], so it applies cluster-wide.

findings.title: developers group can delete pods cluster-wide
findings.verification_evidence: Group:/developers can delete pods only in namespace "dev" (via devs-pods -> pod-admin), not cluster-wide. The only cluster-wide pod deleter is ServiceAccount:kube-system/argocd-manager (cluster-admin).

findings.title: default service account in prod is cluster-admin
findings.verification_evidence: who_can for verb * on resource * cluster-wide lists only ServiceAccount:kube-system/argocd-manager (via argocd-manager -> cluster-admin). prod/default is not listed and has no namespaced grants.

findings.title: argocd-manager is bound to cluster-admin
findings.verification_evidence: ClusterRoleBinding argocd-manager has roleRef ClusterRole/cluster-admin, with subject ServiceAccount argocd-manager in kube-system.

findings.title: alice can exec into pods in staging
findings.verification_evidence: who_can create pods/exec in staging lists User:/alice, namespaced in staging, via alice-exec -> execer, with no resourceNames limit.
